sources.title: Approved Collective Investment Schemes
CMA Approves Ziidi Money Market Fund From Safaricom PLC

verification_events.note: CMA granted approval to Safaricom PLC to establish Ziidi as a collective investment scheme.
The scheme appears in the CMA approved CIS register.

sample_marketing_text: Invest through M-PESA in a regulated money market fund designed to help customers grow savings through diversified short-term investments.
notes: Matched because it is mobile-first, mass-market and investment-return oriented, while regulatory approval is directly verifiable.
